bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears' backfield took another hit as running back Kyle Monangai continued to sit out practice with thumb and toe injuries, and the team placed Zavier Scott on injured reserve just days after he was promoted for depth. Bears running back Kyle Monangai misses practice again while Zavier Scott lands on IR.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers received a mix of injury updates ahead of their Week 9 matchup against the New England Patriots, as coach Matt LaFleur shared encouraging news on Keisean Nixon's groin injury, delivering the positive update just two days before Green Bay travels to New England , while the team also officially ruled out LB Zaire Franklin (shin), OL Travis Glover (knee), C Sean Rhyan (ankle), and TE Josh Whyle for the contest. Adding to the injury-report buzz, star pass-rusher Micah Parsons took a significant step toward making his regular-season debut when the Packers opened his 21-day practice window , giving Green Bay a potential boost as they look to build on their momentum entering the Patriots game.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story is the quarterback shakeup ahead of Monday Night Football against the Buffalo Bills, as head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Kyler Murray will be sidelined for the Vikings Monday Night Football game with a hamstring strain , prompting Carson Wentz to be stated to start Monday night's game against the Bills . Adding to the offensive uncertainty, Jauan Jennings was limited in Thursday's practice with a calf injury, giving him an extra day to recover before the Vikings play the Bills on Monday night , while Minnesota also named Max Brosmer as the backup quarterback for Week 9 with Murray hurt .
